item.title: Patchwork v0.8.1-beta
item.description: Patchwork now has a new angled ticket logo across the website header, footer, favicons, and Open Graph previews. Every public page on `getpatchwork.in` now ships per-section Open Graph cards, JSON-LD structured data, and sitemap indexing. The website now features a streamlined header, a multi-column footer with a Made in India tribute, and mobile tap-target fixes.

item.title: Patchwork v0.8.0-beta
item.description: You can now watch tickets, `@mention` teammates with real-time notifications, and see live viewers and typing indicators on tickets. You can now send immediate or digest SMTP emails and signed outbound webhooks to Slack, Discord, Mattermost, or custom HTTP endpoints. Every loading state now uses surface-derived OKLCH skeletons with command bar inline argument pills and compact ticket header controls.

item.title: Patchwork v0.7.1-beta
item.description: You can now install Patchwork with only Node.js and git using the new Easy mode default. You can now manage PostgreSQL, MinIO, and the app together via `npm run start`, `npm run stop`, and `npm run status`.

item.title: Patchwork v0.7.0-beta
item.description: You can now run Patchwork natively on Windows and Linux with multi-team Kanban boards, Calendar view, and real-time sync. You can now use the Spotlight command bar (`Ctrl+K` / `Cmd+K`) with slash commands, inline ghost hints, and scoped full-text search. You can now browse official documentation directly inside the app at `/documentation`.
